## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Keep scope focused.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. For device/ROM changes, include app version,
phone/ROM, card product, backend and the operations actually exercised. Mark
simulated checks as simulated and untested operations as untested.

## Compatibility or safety implications

Explain any transport, authorization, identity, cleanup or recovery change.
Keep full identifiers, credentials, raw traces and per-session evidence bundles
out of the PR and source tree. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sidnvy/8bercue/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
